---
name: Feature or backlog suggestion
about: Suggest a capability, or a fix to something in docs/BACKLOG.md
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What's missing or could be better**
A clear description of the gap.

**Is this already tracked?**
Check `docs/BACKLOG.md` first — if it matches an existing `BL-WEB-NN` item,
reference it instead of duplicating.

**Why it matters**
Who this helps and what it unblocks. This project favours real, evidenced
need over speculative capability — see `docs/DOCTRINE.md`.

**Rough shape of a solution (optional)**
Sketch it if you have one; not required.

**Anything this must not break**
This project has non-negotiables (single-file delivery, no colour-only
signalling, AA contrast in every theme, no storage APIs — see `CLAUDE.md`).
Flag if your suggestion has tension with any of these.
